summary: The diff implements comprehensive batch payment functionality across frontend and backend. All four requirements appear to be addressed: invoice selection (REQ-1), RTGS/online transfer payment mode (REQ-2), cheque payment mode (REQ-3), and backend batch payment processing (REQ-4). The implementation includes InvoiceSelector component for multi-invoice selection, BatchPaymentForm for payment details, BatchPaymentEntryPage orchestration, backend enterBatchPayment method, and proper query hooks with cache invalidation.

hallucinated_features.description: Addition of useAddBatchPayment mutation hook and enterBatchPayment backend method
hallucinated_features.reason: While batch payment functionality was requested, the BuildRequest did not explicitly specify creating a new backend method called 'enterBatchPayment' or a frontend hook called 'useAddBatchPayment'. The requirement stated to verify backend handles batch payments (REQ-4), which could have been interpreted as using existing methods.
